title: The Artificial Intelligence Revolution: From Algorithms to Consciousness
description: Chronicles AI's evolution from basic algorithms to potential consciousness, exploring its technological, ethical, and societal implications.
short_description: A plain-English guide to AI in artificial intelligence itself, focused on practical use, trade-offs, and sharper questions.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: Readers who want a grounded, non-technical view of AI in artificial intelligence itself, including AI-curious readers, strategists, students, and anyone trying to separate substance from theatre.
